name: Pekanbaru

queries.query: Pekanbaru peta bidang tanah GIS resmi geoportal Dinas Pertanahan ATR BPN Smart Petaku
queries.scope: Find a current official Pekanbaru parcel map and anonymous full-geometry route.
queries.result: Official sources document city land-asset GIS (Smart Petaku) and a local BPN Zone of Land Value map. The current city GeoPortal publicly lists CCTV, water-pipe and administrative services; the residential/building map is login-gated and not cadastral. ATR/BPN BHUMI publishes a national Bidang Tanah layer, but the viewer uses WMS map images; the anonymous image request to the official public proxy at the queued point returned HTTP 403, and no full vector response was obtained.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

queries.query: Pekanbaru official cadastral parcel GIS public geospatial map land asset BPN
queries.scope: Cross-check current city GIS offerings and anonymous national cadastral-map schema.
queries.result: The city’s 2024 official publication describes Smart Petaku as a municipal-government land-asset WebGIS, not a complete cadastral parcel data service. BHUMI’s default published layer is Bidang Tanah with map_service_url `/bhumigs/umum`, GeoServer, layer `umum:Persil`; its anonymous client renders WMS tiles rather than vector features. Current city portal does not expose an open parcel layer.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

portals.name: Pekanbaru GeoPortal / Satu Peta
portals.observation: Current official portal lists public CCTV and PDAM maps. The 65,296-building population map requires staff authentication under the city’s privacy notice; it was not accessed and is not a cadastral parcel service.

portals.name: Smart Petaku
portals.observation: Official 2024 city publication describes a government asset land/building WebGIS; current home responded with a temporary-service message and the historical /peta route returned 404. No geometry retrieved.

portals.name: BHUMI ATR/BPN Bidang Tanah
portals.operator: Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional
portals.observation: Public nationwide map layer identifies registered land parcels; public layer metadata lists Penggunaan, Tipe Hak, Luas, NIB and Akurasi. Viewer uses WMS raster tiles; no owner fields were requested and no full geometry was obtained.

requests.observation: Anonymous metadata returns default published layer Bidang Tanah; map_service_vendor GeoServer; map_service_url /bhumigs/umum; layer umum:Persil; displayed fields include land-use/type/area/NIB/accuracy. No feature data queried.
Public viewer route fetches published layer metadata; map component rewrites the default parcel service to /mprx/service and requests WMS GetMap images.

A direct anonymous WMS GetMap request for a 500 m box around the Pekanbaru WUP point was denied with HTTP 403; no response body or map geometry retained. Denial is not treated as provider outage or definitive layer absence.
Current city portal states three service modules: CCTV, PDAM piping and a staff-gated residential/building map; no cadastral parcel layer listed.
Local client timed out while attempting the older GeoNode Satu Peta Bapenda host; no provider-outage conclusion drawn.

historicalContext.observation: City publication describes Smart Petaku as a WebGIS of municipally owned land/building assets; it does not establish open cadastral vector access.

source.name: BHUMI ATR/BPN Bidang Tanah (national visual layer)
source.operator: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
source.serviceType: Public web map using GeoServer WMS raster tiles through /mprx/service. Anonymous direct map-image request to the queued point returned HTTP 403.
source.layer: Published default layer Bidang Tanah; service layer umum:Persil.
source.geometryType: Polygon layer rendered as map image; no full polygon response retrieved.
source.outputCrs: Viewer requests map tiles in EPSG:3857; feature geometry output CRS not available.
source.nativeIdEvidence: Layer metadata documents NIB as an attribute; no feature-level identity response was requested or obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: BHUMI national map catalog includes registered land-parcel layer; Pekanbaru local BPN and municipal sources document land mapping activity.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-located full polygon retrieved. Default BHUMI layer is consumed as WMS images and direct anonymous map request was denied; no vector response/identity was verified.

technicalBlocker: Public viewer exposes the national parcel layer as WMS images; direct anonymous WMS request at the WUP point returned 403. The city’s current public GeoPortal has no parcel layer; historical Smart Petaku is government-land asset mapping.
remainingUncertainty: Whether ATR/BPN offers a separate public vector route for the Pekanbaru cadastre, and whether Smart Petaku’s current replacement publishes municipal asset polygons anonymously.
nextStep: If continuing, locate an officially documented vector export/service available without login; do not access the staff-gated residential/building map or query NIB/property details.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A public national cadastral map layer is documented, but only image rendering was verified and the direct anonymous WMS request was denied.

registryBasis: Official Pekanbaru municipal and Riau provincial reports identify the BPN land office in Pekanbaru and local land certification/registration services. City land-value and municipal asset maps also exist, but no public parcel-vector geometry at the WUP point was verified. The national BHUMI layer alone is not the city registry-presence basis.
